text: Determine which clinical concepts can be reliably predicted from images, and identify data-quality issues such as class imbalance, near-duplicates, and noisy captions.

questions.phrase: Determine which clinical concepts can be reliably predicted from images
identify data-quality issues such as class imbalance, near-duplicates, and noisy captions

constraints.reliability_rule: >= 20 positive evaluation samples, lower 95% DeLong bound of AUROC >= 0.8, BH-adjusted p < 0.05 against AUROC 0.5; fewer positives: too rare to assess
